messages:
harper: Heads-up: found a reproducible parity bug across bundlers when our JS/TS SDK is consumed by edge-targeted sampleapps. Default import disappears and types point to the CJS build.

lee: Oof. Which bundlers and quick repro?

harper: Repro (monorepo):
1) packages/sdk/package.json -> name: "@redwood/sdk" main: "dist/index.cjs.js" module: "dist/index.esm.js" types: "dist/index.d.ts"
2) packages/sdk/src/index.ts -> export default function predict(){ return 'ok' }
3) apps/sample imports: `import predict from '@redwood/sdk'` and is built with either: (A) webpack5+ts-loader target:webworker, (B) Vite + @rollup/plugin-commonjs, (C) Rollup + esbuild plugin + commonjs.
Observed: runtime on edge emu -> TypeError: predict is not a function. Bundles show CJS wrappers or legacy/System registers; sourcemaps reference cjs file.

toni: Ah classic. Bundler resolved `main` (CJS) in workspace, wrapped it, and minifier/optimizer removed interop helpers so default mapping vanished.

lee: Workarounds?

harper: Things that fixed it locally: (1) Add explicit `exports` in SDK package.json: "\"exports\": {\"import\":\"dist/index.esm.js\",\"require\":\"dist/index.cjs.js\"}" and keep `types` pointing to ESM d.ts. (2) For Vite, set `resolve.mainFields = ['module','main']` or `resolve.preserveSymlinks = true` for workspace setups. (3) For webpack, prefer `module` via `resolve.mainFields` and/or set `esModuleInterop`.

toni: Also temporary consumer fallback: `import * as sdk from '@redwood/sdk'` then use `sdk.default()` — ugly but useful while debugging.

lee: Action items for DX: add publish-lint that warns when package has main+module but no exports, update sampleapp templates to prefer `exports` and include short note on plugin ordering (commonjs after esbuild can break types), and add CI smoke that builds sampleapp with webpack+vite+rollup combos and asserts basic runtime behavior.

harper: I pushed a tiny repro: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repro-edge-bundler-parity (branch: devex/bundler-parity). Will open PR to add the publish-lint and sampleapp CI matrix.

build-bot: CI: reproduce-build #128 failed (see: https://ci.company/128) :warning: - linked to repro branch.

toni: One more note: include a short onboarding doc snippet: recommended `package.json` snippet, brief explanation of why `exports` matters for edge, and the quick fallback `import * as` tip so new hires can debug fast.

harper: Will add PR with docs + lint + CI smoke. Posting results here when green.
